band_relabel_note: The band-half-width comparison is a coarser yardstick: movement vs the config-selection spread of the score level (how much this model's own score moves around just from which 12 configs get picked, at a fixed context length). The paired bootstrap CI on the difference itself is the primary test; the band comparison is reported alongside it, secondary.
